The *Vipattivāra* (Pvr 1.11) is an analytical subsection of the *Parivāra*, the final collection of the Vinaya Piṭaka. The text systematically analyzes the monastic disciplinary rules by relating them to categories of "falling away" or failure (*vipatti*) from proper monastic conduct. An English translation of the section has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
